targets.query:
from(bucket: "fairbanks_climate")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "climate" and r._field == "temperature_c")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "temperature")

from(bucket: "fairbanks_climate")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "climate" and r._field == "precipitation_mm")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "precipitation")

panels.title: Downsampled Daily Average Temperature (last 30 days, retention-bound bucket)

targets.query:
from(bucket: "fairbanks_climate_downsampled")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "climate" and r._field == "temperature_c")
  |> yield(name: "daily_avg_temperature")

data = from(bucket: "fairbanks_climate")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "climate" and r._field == "temperature_c")

meanVal = (data |> mean(column: "_value") |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0))._value
stddevVal = (data |> stddev(column: "_value") |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0))._value

data
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value > meanVal + 2.0 * stddevVal or r._value < meanVal - 2.0 * stddevVal)
  |> count()

from(bucket: "fairbanks_climate")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "climate" and r._field == "temperature_c")
  |> last()
